screens.notes:
NARROW WINDOW (single LazyColumn under a transparent top bar):
TOP BAR: back arrow; title = manga title, alpha 0 while header row is visible and fades to 1 once scrolled; background surfaceColorAtElevation(3dp) also fades in on scroll. Actions: Download (icon, opens dropdown 'Next chapter', 'Next 5 chapters', 'Next 10 chapters', 'Next 25 chapters', 'Unread'; hidden for local source), Filter icon (tinted 'active' color when any chapter filter is set; opens Chapter settings sheet). Overflow: Refresh, Edit categories (library only), Migrate (library only), Share (http sources), Settings (configurable source -> Source preferences screen).
SELECTION MODE TOP BAR: close (X) icon, title = selected count, actions 'Select all' (select-all icon) and 'Select inverse' (flip icon); background fully opaque. Back press clears selection.
1) INFO BOX: full-width backdrop = cover image, ContentScale.Crop, blur 4dp, alpha 0.2, vertical gradient transparent->background. On top a Row (padding 16dp start/end, top = appbar height + 16dp, spacing 16dp): cover (book ratio 2:3, max width 100dp, rounded, tap -> full cover dialog) aligned top; Column (2dp spacing): title (titleLarge; tap = global search, long-press = copy; 'Unknown title' fallback); row [person icon 16dp] author (titleSmall, secondary alpha; 'Unknown author'; tap = global search); optional row [brush icon] artist if different; row [status icon 16dp] status text (bodyMedium: Ongoing/Completed/Licensed/Publishing finished/Cancelled/On hiatus/Unknown with icons schedule/done-all/attach-money/done/close/pause/block) ' • ' source name (tap = search in that source; red warning icon before it when source is missing/stub).
2) ACTION ROW: Row padding 16dp start/end 8dp top, 4 equal-weight TextButtons, each a centered column: icon 20dp, 4dp gap, label 12sp. a) 'In library' (filled heart, primary color) / 'Add to library' (outline heart, disabled-alpha grey); long-press = Set categories. b) Next update: hourglass icon; label 'N/A' (null), 'Soon' (0 days) or '3 days'; primary-tinted when user set a custom interval; tap = Smart update interval dialog. c) Tracking: sync icon + 'Tracking' when no trackers, done icon + '1 tracker'/'2 trackers' in primary when tracked; tap = tracking sheet. d) 'WebView' (globe icon; only for http sources; long-press = open in browser).
3) DESCRIPTION: bodyMedium, secondary alpha, selectable text, padding 16dp horizontal 8dp top; collapsed shows ~3 lines with a 24dp gradient scrim and animated caret (contentDescription 'More'/'Less'); tap toggles. 'No description' placeholder. Expanded by default when opened from a source. GENRE CHIPS below (8dp + 12dp vertical padding): collapsed = single horizontally scrolling LazyRow of small SuggestionChips (bodySmall, 4dp vertical padding, 4dp gaps, 16dp content padding); expanded = FlowRow wrapping. Tapping a chip opens a dropdown: 'Search' (search tag in source), 'Copy to clipboard'.
4) LIST HEADER: clickable (opens chapter settings sheet) column padding 16dp/4dp: '12 chapters' (titleMedium; 'Chapters' if count unknown); under it in error color bodySmall 'Missing 3 items' when chapter numbers have gaps.
5) CHAPTER ROWS: Row padding start 16 top 12 end 8 bottom 12, selected = tinted background. Left column (weight 1, 6dp spacing): line 1 = [unread dot: filled circle 8dp primary, only if unread] [bookmark icon filled, primary, sized to text height, only if bookmarked] title (bodyMedium, 1 line ellipsis; 'Chapter 12' when display mode = chapter number, else source name); read chapters drawn at disabled alpha (0.38). line 2 (bodySmall, secondary alpha, or disabled when read): upload date (relative: 'Today', 'Yesterday', '2 days ago' or date) • 'Page 5' progress (disabled alpha, only when partially read) • scanlator. Right: download indicator 48dp touch target: not downloaded = outlined download-circle icon; queued = indeterminate ring; downloading = determinate ring with arrow-down inside; downloaded = filled check-circle; error = error-outline icon. Tapping indicator: not downloaded -> start; queued/downloading -> menu 'Start downloading now'/'Cancel'; downloaded -> menu 'Delete'. Indicator hidden while selecting or for local source. Long-press selects (range select with subsequent long-press), tap while selecting toggles. MISSING-COUNT divider row between gaps: [divider] 'Missing 3 items' (labelMedium, secondary alpha) [divider].
FAB: ExtendedFloatingActionButton bottom-end, play icon + 'Start' (nothing read yet) / 'Resume'; hidden when all read or when selecting; collapses to icon-only while scrolling down.
SELECTION BOTTOM BAR: Surface surfaceContainerHigh, large top corners, row of equal-weight 48dp icon buttons (8dp/12dp padding); only applicable ones appear: Bookmark (bookmark-add), Remove bookmark (bookmark-remove), Mark as read (done-all), Mark as unread (remove-done), Mark previous as read (done-prev; only when exactly 1 selected), Download, Delete (only when some downloaded). Long-press a button expands it (weight 2) and reveals its label for 1s.
WIDE WINDOW: two panels; left scrollable column = info box with cover centered at 65% width and text centered, action row, description expanded; right = chapter list with header. Bottom action bar takes half width aligned end.

screens.notes:
Same skeleton as manga_entry_details (transparent fading top bar, info box, action row, description, list header, rows, FAB, selection bottom bar) with these differences. Content is a LazyVerticalGrid (14dp grid padding) so seasons can render as a grid; non-season items span the full width.
TOP BAR overflow adds 'Change intro length' (first; opens Skip intro length wheel picker 0s..255s). Settings item -> anime source preferences.
INFO BOX: backdrop uses the anime background image (falls back to cover). Author row shows the studio/author (person icon), artist row (brush icon) when different. Extra status 'Upcoming' (calendar-clock icon).
ACTION ROW identical: In library / Add to library, next-update days, Tracking (hidden when no trackers are logged in), WebView.
DESCRIPTION: below genre chips, RELATED ANIME rows (when source provides relations): small groups packed into rows of up to N slots, each group = relation name (titleSmall) above its cover cards; larger groups get their own heading + horizontal LazyRow of cover cards (comfortable/compact/cover-only grid style per library display mode). Tap opens anime, long-press adds to library.
LIST HEADER: '12 episodes' or '3 seasons' (anime with fetchType = Seasons), 'Missing N items' warning. Tap opens Episode settings or Season settings sheet respectively.
SEASONS (fetchType Seasons): cards in the chosen Season display mode (compact/comfortable/cover-only grid with Items per row, or list with List size): cover, title ('Season 2' when display = season number), badges top-start = downloaded count + unseen count, top-end = language/local badge, optional 'continue watching' play button overlay bottom-end. Tap opens that season's anime screen.
NEXT EPISODE AIRING row (before episodes, if source gives airing time and setting enabled and status != completed): primary-colored text at secondary alpha, line 1 'Episode 13', line 2 live countdown 'Airing in 02d 05h 13m 09s'.
EPISODE ROWS: padding start 16 top 12 end 8 bottom 12. Simple form (no preview, no summary): title line (bodyMedium, disabled alpha when seen) then info line; right side = [bookmark icon primary] + download indicator. Info line (bodySmall): [label icon + 'Filler' in tertiary color if fillermarked] date • watch progress '12:34/24:00' (disabled alpha, only partially seen) • scanlator. No unread dot. Rich form (episode thumbnails and/or summaries enabled and available): Row [thumbnail 16:9, width = 40% screen max 250dp, 8dp end padding] [Column: title (2 lines when thumbnail present), summary text 10sp, 3 lines min, tap to expand]; below a full-width row with the info line and bookmark+download icons at end. Tapping an episode plays it (internal or external player per preference). Long-press selects.
DOWNLOAD (indicator or toolbar) may open the 'episode_options' quality dialog when the source has multiple hosters: episode title (bold titleSmall), italic 'Choose video quality:', expandable hoster rows each listing qualities; tapping a quality reveals Copy / Use internal downloader / Use external downloader / Play externally / Play internally rows with icons.
SELECTION BOTTOM BAR adds: Fillermark episode (new-label icon) / Remove fillermark (label-off), labels 'Bookmark episode', 'Remove bookmark', 'Mark as seen', 'Mark as unseen', 'Mark previous as seen', and with exactly one selected 'Play externally' (open-in-new icon) or 'Play internally' (input icon) depending on the always-use-external-player preference.
FAB: play icon + 'Start'/'Resume' (based on seen state).

screens.notes:
Bottom sheet (AdaptiveSheet) opened from the Tracking action button. Column, padding 16dp, 24dp spacing between trackers, scrollable.
BOUND TRACKER: header Row: tracker logo tile (48dp rounded square in tracker brand color; tap = open in browser, long-press = copy link; small primary badge with eye-off icon when 'Tracked privately') | title (titleMedium, 1 line, 48dp tall, weight 1, padding start 16; tap = re-search, long-press = copy title) | vertical divider | overflow (more-vert) menu: Open in browser, Copy link, Track privately/Track publicly (if supported), Remove. Below (12dp top): rounded card surfaceContainerHighest padding 8dp containing a grid of cells divided by thin dividers: row 1 = Status | '12 / 24' chapters (or episodes) | Score (only if tracker supports scoring); row 2 (if dates supported) = Start date | Finish date. Each cell: centered bodyMedium, 12dp padding, unset values show placeholder at 50% alpha. Tapping a cell opens its picker dialog.
UNBOUND TRACKER: Row [logo] [full-width TextButton 'Add tracking'].
Pickers: Status = radio list in a scrolling column; Chapters/Episodes = wheel number picker (0..total or 0..10000); Score = wheel text picker (options come from the tracker, e.g. 0-10, 0-100, stars, smileys); Dates = Material date picker with Remove/Cancel/OK. Tracker error snackbar: 'AniList error: message'.

screens.title: Track search
screens.notes:
Full-screen dialog. TOP APP BAR: back arrow, inline search text field (placeholder 'Search…', prefilled with entry title, IME search submits) and a clear (X) icon when text present.
BODY: loading spinner, 'No results found', 'Unknown error' or error message, else LazyColumn (12dp vertical padding & spacing) of result cards: card = rounded 16dp, surface background, 12dp horizontal margin, 12dp inner padding; selected card gets a 2dp outline border and a primary check-circle icon at top-end. Content Row: cover (book ratio, 96dp tall), 12dp gap, Column: title (titleMedium, 2 lines, 28dp end padding), authors/artists joined (bodySmall secondary, 1 line), then detail lines 'Type: Manga', 'Started: 2020-01-01', 'Status: Publishing', 'Score: 8.4' where label is titleSmall and value bodyMedium. Below the row: description (bodySmall, secondary, 4 lines). Long-press card = menu (Copy to clipboard, Open in browser).
BOTTOM BAR (animated in when a result is selected): Row padding 8dp: elevated Button 'Track' (weight 1) and, if tracker supports private tracking, an elevated icon Button with eye-off icon ('Track privately').

screens.notes:
Bottom-nav tab 'Browse' (TabbedScreen). Title 'Browse'; scrollable primary tab row with 6 tabs in this order: 'Anime Sources', 'Manga Sources', 'Anime Extensions', 'Manga Extensions' (extension tabs show a numeric badge = pending updates), 'Migrate Anime', 'Migrate'. Toolbar actions change per tab.
SOURCES TABS (anime/manga): actions Global search (travel-explore icon) and Filter (filter-list icon -> Sources filter screen). LazyColumn of sections. Section header text (header typography, padding 16dp/8dp) in order: 'Last used' (single most recent source), 'Pinned', then one section per language sorted by display name ('Multi' for all-language sources, 'Other' for unknown, 'Local source'). Source row (BaseBrowseItem: padding 16dp/8dp, vertically centered): source icon (40dp, extension icon; red warning icon if missing) | column weight 1, padding 16dp: name (bodyMedium) + language (bodySmall, secondary alpha) | 'Latest' TextButton in primary color (only if source supports latest; opens Browse source in Latest) | pin IconButton (filled push-pin primary when pinned, outlined secondary alpha otherwise). Tap row = browse Popular; long-press = source options dialog. Empty: 'No source found'. Snackbar on failure: 'InternalError: Check crash logs for further information'.
EXTENSIONS TABS: search icon in toolbar turns title into a search field (filters by name). Overflow: 'Filter' (-> Extension filter languages screen) and 'Extension repos' (manga) / 'Extension stores' (anime). Optional warning banner at top: 'Permissions are needed to install extensions. Tap here to grant.' Sections: 'Updates pending' header with a filled Button 'Update all' at the end, 'Installed' (installed + untrusted), then available extensions grouped under language headers. Extension row: 40dp icon (circular progress ring around it while pending/downloading/installing, icon shrinks with 8dp padding) | column: name (bodyMedium) + FlowRow bodySmall secondary: language (installed only), version name, red uppercase warning 'UNTRUSTED' / 'ORPHANED' / '18+', and ' • Pending'/'Downloading'/'Installing' during install | trailing icon buttons: in progress = Cancel (X); error = Retry (refresh); installed = Settings (gear -> extension details) + Update (get-app icon) when update available; untrusted = Trust (verified-user icon -> trust dialog); available = 'Open in WebView' (globe) + Install (get-app). Tap: available = install, installed = details, untrusted = trust dialog. Long-press: available = install, installed = uninstall. Empty: 'Well, this is awkward' (or 'No results found' when searching) with action button 'Extension repos'.
MIGRATE TABS: action 'Source migration guide' (help icon, opens web guide). Empty: 'Your library is empty'. Sticky header row: 'Select a source to migrate from' (header style, weight 1) + sort-mode IconButton (sort-by-alpha icon 'Alphabetically' / numbers icon 'Total entries') + direction IconButton (arrow-up 'Ascending' / arrow-down 'Descending'). Rows: source icon | name (or id) + language (secondary) and red 'Not installed' for stub sources | count badge pill (number of library entries). Tap -> migrate entries screen; long-press copies source id.

screens.notes:
TOP: SearchToolbar: back arrow, title = source name; search icon expands to text field (IME search runs query). Actions: 'Display mode' icon (view-list icon when List, view-module otherwise) opening a dropdown of radio items 'Comfortable grid', 'Compact grid', 'List'; overflow 'Open in WebView' (non-local) or 'Help' (local source) and 'Settings' (configurable sources). Under the toolbar a horizontally scrolling row of FilterChips (8dp padding/spacing): 'Popular' (favorite heart icon), 'Latest' (new-releases icon, only if supported), 'Filter' (filter-list icon, only if source has filters; selected when a search/filter is active; opens filter sheet). Thin divider below.
BODY (paged, infinite scroll): Comfortable grid = cover cards with title below (2 lines), Compact grid = title overlaid on cover bottom gradient, List = rows with small cover + title. Columns from library 'items per row' setting (adaptive when 0). Entries already in library show an 'in library' badge (collections-bookmark icon) at top-start and the cover is dimmed. Bottom loading spinner while appending. Tap opens entry details; long-press: in library -> 'Are you sure?' remove dialog; duplicate found -> duplicate dialog; else adds to library (category dialog if categories exist).
ERRORS: if nothing loaded, EmptyScreen with error text and action buttons 'Retry' (refresh), 'Open in WebView' (globe), 'Help'; local source shows 'Local source guide'. If pages loaded, snackbar error with 'Retry' action. Missing source: top bar with name, body 'Source not installed: %1$s'.
FILTER SHEET (AdaptiveSheet): sticky header row: 'Reset' TextButton (primary) left, spacer, filled 'Filter' Button right; divider; then the source's filter list rendered by type (heading, divider, checkbox row, tri-state checkbox row, text field, dropdown select, collapsible sort with asc/desc arrows, collapsible group). Same screen for anime sources.

screens.title: Global search
screens.notes:
TOP (surface background): SearchToolbar with search field (back arrow / close X pops; IME search runs). Thin LinearProgressIndicator pinned to the toolbar bottom while sources are still searching (progress/total). Row of FilterChips (horizontal scroll, 8dp): 'Pinned' (push-pin icon), 'All' (done-all icon) - mutually exclusive; vertical divider; 'Has results' toggle (filter-list icon). Divider.
BODY: LazyColumn with one block per source: header row (padding start 16, end 4): column [source name titleMedium, language below] + trailing arrow-forward IconButton (opens browse_source with the query). Below: loading = centered small circular progress; success = horizontal LazyRow (8dp padding, 4dp spacing) of 96dp-wide comfortable grid cards (cover + 3-line title, in-library badge and dimmed cover for favorites) or 'No results found' text; error = error icon + message ('Unknown error'). Tap card opens details, long-press also opens details. Reselecting the Browse nav tab opens this screen. Same for anime and manga.

screens.title: WebView
screens.notes: Top app bar: navigation icon = Close (X); title = page title (fallback to initial/source name), subtitle = current URL (single line). Actions: Back and Forward arrow icons (disabled when history unavailable); overflow Refresh, Share, Open in browser, Clear cookies. Below the bar: a thin LinearProgressIndicator (indeterminate while initializing, determinate while loading). When a Cloudflare challenge page is detected, a WarningBanner 'Tap here for help with Cloudflare' appears under the bar (tap opens help). Body = full WebView with the source's headers/user agent.
